## Pull request overview

This PR adds closed-loop powder dosing to the bench test-module by integrating an A&D HR-100A analytical balance over RS-232, enabling a two-phase controller (coarse auger fill + fine solenoid tap trim) for demo-ready dosing under scale feedback.

**Changes:**
- Adds RS-232 hardware interface (MAX3232 on Pico UART0) plus ngspice verification and updated bench-wiring documentation.
- Implements MicroPython scale driver + closed-loop dosing controller and exposes dosing via the existing serial REPL (`g <grams>`, `w`, `z`).
- Adds a CPython simulation harness and unit tests that exercise the same `scale.py`/`dosing.py` logic shipped to the Pico.
